title: ghostty-window-nudge
goal: Move the extra Ghostty, type, move again. This Space only.
rules: Do not Hyper+P or Hyper+J. Do not paste into Herdr.
Do not click the titlebar folder/path chip (center).
Titlebar drag handle: window.x + window.width - 70, window.y + 12.
Do not resize the 1720-wide tiles. Only the ~800-wide window moves.
